title: NotificationCreated
description: A message landed in a user's notification feed: from an event, or from an admin announcement (`kind: announcement`). `side` is the side the notice is for, shown only in that side's app; a notice about the person has none and every app shows it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

data.description: What the app needs to open the right screen when the item is tapped: the same keys the push carries, such as `booking_id`, `load_id` or `ticket_id`. Empty for an announcement.

unread.description: The user's unread feed items, this one included, for the badge.

side.title: MembershipSide
side.description: A side of the market: `shipper`, `carrier`, or `platform` for GoWay's own staff.
